vending-machine.note: Closest approved language available: sheet 07 is boxy 1990s consumer electronics (CRT, VCR, boombox), the same family of object as a vending machine. Only a 384x256 lossy preview survives in the repo.

mall-bench.note: NO REFERENCE EXISTS. The approved set covers the player, palettes, scale, portraits, held equipment and item art. There is no furniture or environment board, so a bench has no subject anchor -- only the palette and the written style rules.
